statement: A signature, contract, or other record relating to a transaction in or affecting interstate commerce may not be denied legal effect, validity, or enforceability solely because it is in electronic form or because an electronic signature or record was used in its formation (15 U.S.C. § 7001(a)(1)-(2)).
caveat: Consumer disclosures required by law to be in writing carry the § 7001(c) consent procedure, and some documents (wills, certain notices) are carved out by § 7003. State UETA adoptions can displace parts of E-SIGN. This repo does not validate a specific signing flow.
